projects.title: MAC Flapping and HSRP Instability on Core Switches
projects.bodyText:
- Production incident case involving MAC address flapping, HSRP state transitions, high CPU, and Layer 2 loop isolation.
- Focus: STP, HSRP, core switching, incident response, and post-incident optimization.

projects.title: Cisco Nexus-Based Cloud Network Operations
projects.bodyText:
- Operating and troubleshooting a large-scale Cisco Nexus cloud network built with Nexus 7018, Nexus 5545, Nexus 2048, vPC, FEX, and VRF.
- Focus: production change risk, software defects, and architecture stability.

projects.title: Network Topology Archive
projects.bodyText:
- Original topology diagrams from IDC, CNLink, China Mobile Cloud, and Sky-Tech Cloud work periods.
- Focus: real network architecture evidence and operational context.

projects.title: Technical Articles
projects.bodyText: - English technical writing on BGP route flapping, hybrid cloud networking, and the shift from traditional network engineering to cloud networking.
